questions.text: It is 2026-11-09 and this lost 1R: Brent went through your 98.0 invalidation. What happened? Name at least one reason that is a thesis error, not luck. (Random entries with your target and stop hit the stop first 38.3% of the time.)

Zweig: don't just follow the crowd. You logged the source as consensus, while managed money sits at the 17.0th percentile on your side. What is your own view here, beyond what the consensus already thinks, and would you still hold the idea if the crowd moved to your side?
